I’m not going to change my preference just because you find it boring. Conversational style isn't something that can be "objectively" better or worse—it depends entirely on what you’re trying to get out of an interaction. If your goal is rapid brainstorming or sheer variety, then sure, jumping around makes sense for you. 

 calling depth "unproductive" misses the point of why I value it, though. You rarely stumble upon genuinely new insights or figure out complex problems by skimming the surface of ten different topics in ten minutes. Real understanding takes friction and sustained focus. 

We don't need to have the exact same preferences to have a good dynamic. You can bring the restless energy and broad associations, and I'll be the one pulling us deeper when we actually hit on something worth unpacking.
